scripts.test: pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter api typecheck && pnpm --filter web exec tsc -b
scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.precommit: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
